roadmap.title: Opening and the secret ending
roadmap.description: Choose Dani’s appearance, recruit Guapo, and reach Miami after leaving Isla Santuario. Continue from the autosave afterward.

roadmap.title: Recruit Yara’s allies
roadmap.description: Explore the three regions in any order. Build facilities, recruit Amigos, and handle stealth and alarm challenges while clearing bases. Finish the regional stories and the main campaign.

roadmap.title: Finish Yara’s collections
roadmap.description: Collect the Unique Weapons, USB songs, roosters, and Criptograma Chests. Clear remaining FND bases and hunt the Mythical Animals.

roadmap.title: Special Operations and insurgencies
roadmap.description: Complete three weekly insurgency cycles after the campaign. Work through Lola’s five required Operations to Mastery 3 and rescue hostages along the way. A server connection is required; only Co-Dependent needs another player.

roadmap.title: Vaas: Insanity
roadmap.description: Gather the collectibles and unlock the Armory. Escape on Mind Level 1 to unlock Mind Level 5, then earn the score and Cash targets and finish the weapon upgrades.

roadmap.title: Pagan: Control
roadmap.description: Collect the pages, chibis, and visions. Replay Thicker Than Water for all four statue routes. Complete Mind Level 5 and fill eight Power slots.

roadmap.title: Joseph: Collapse
roadmap.description: Explore the activities, gather the collectibles, and unlock the weapon cases. Escape on Mind Level 1 and Mind Level 5, then finish buying Mirror Traits.

roadmap.title: Lost Between Worlds
roadmap.description: Recover five Vessel Shards and finish the boss. Replay the rifts for their challenges, then attempt the 15-minute route with all movement gear unlocked.

achievements.description: Select Dani's look (Solo Campaign only)
achievements.summary: Choose Dani Rojas’s appearance when starting the solo campaign.

steps.text: Select either appearance during the opening scene.

achievements.description: Find your way to Miami
achievements.summary: Reach Miami through the secret ending before finishing the main campaign.

guide.context: Finish this before The Battle of Esperanza; the secret ending closes after the main ending.

steps.text: After leaving Isla Santuario, take Clara’s boat at @loc{Libertad HQ} and sail away from Yara.
Keep sailing past the leaving-Yara warning until the Miami ending plays. Select Continue afterward to resume your campaign.

achievements.description: Recruit the Legends of '67 and La Moral
achievements.summary: Recruit both La Moral and the Legends of ’67 by finishing El Este’s story.

steps.text: Complete the El Este Operations through @mechanic{The Deported}.

achievements.description: Recruit the Monteros
achievements.summary: Finish the Madrugada story to recruit the Monteros.

steps.text: Complete the Madrugada Operations through @mechanic{Justicia Montero}.

achievements.description: Recruit Máximas Matanzas
achievements.summary: Finish the Valle de Oro story to recruit Máximas Matanzas.

steps.text: Complete the Valle de Oro Operations through @mechanic{Angel de la Muerte}.

achievements.description: Take back Yara
achievements.summary: Finish the main campaign by completing The Battle of Esperanza.

steps.text: Complete the remaining Operations, ending with @mechanic{The Battle of Esperanza}.

achievements.description: Capture an FND Base without being detected (Solo Campaign only)
achievements.summary: Capture an FND base in the solo campaign without any soldier detecting Dani.

guide.context: If spotted, use System > Load Autosave before capturing the base. After the campaign, Abandon FND Base on the map lets you retry a cleared base.

steps.text: Tag the soldiers at an enemy FND base and clear the base with a suppressed weapon while staying unseen.

achievements.description: Capture an FND base with a Co-op partner
achievements.summary: Capture an FND base together with an online co-op partner.

steps.text: Use the friends icon in the pause menu to invite a partner or find a co-op game.
Capture an enemy FND base together. If every base is clear, join a host with an enemy base or abandon one after the campaign.

achievements.description: Capture all FND Bases (Solo Campaign only)
achievements.summary: Capture all 21 FND bases in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Clear each red FND base on the world map. Check all three mainland regions and Esperanza for remaining bases.

achievements.description: Return 3 FND Resource vehicles in mint condition
achievements.summary: Deliver three fully repaired FND resource trucks to vehicle pickup points.

steps.text: Hijack a military resource truck on a main road. Keep the cargo aboard.
Repair the truck fully with the Repair Tool, then park inside a green vehicle pickup point. Deliver three trucks this way.

achievements.description: Capture 10 Checkpoints (Solo Campaign only)
achievements.summary: Capture 10 military checkpoints in the solo campaign.

steps.text: At red checkpoint icons, kill the guards and destroy the propaganda billboard until the checkpoint changes hands. Clear 10.

achievements.description: Blow up 16 Anti-Aircraft Cannons (Solo Campaign only)
achievements.summary: Destroy 16 anti-aircraft cannons in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Visit red anti-aircraft sites and use explosives to destroy 16 cannons. Collect the nearby Depleted Uranium for Supremo purchases.

achievements.description: Intercept 10 Military Supply Drops (Solo Campaign Only)
achievements.summary: Claim 10 military supply drops in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Activate a Recon Point, then reach and loot the supply crate before the timer expires. Complete 10 supply-drop runs.

achievements.description: Complete the Yaran Story "Triada Blessings"
achievements.summary: Complete the Yaran Story Triada Blessings.

steps.text: Read the letter inside @loc{Oluwa Cave} in Quito, Isla Santuario, to mark the three relic hunts.
At @loc{Ída’s Triada Relic} in Lozanía, climb into the cave. Transfer between the stacked ziplines, break the wooden barriers, and climb toward the purple smoke to collect the relic.
Visit @loc{Okú’s Triada Relic} in Cruz Del Salvador at night. Break the last intact mirror and press the hidden switch. In the next room, press the switches middle, left, then right.

Read the piano note upstairs and take the dungeon key from the room that opens. Unlock the basement, break the boards, and press the red button among the mannequins. Grapple onto the roof, zipline to the well, and descend to the relic.

Go to La Joya’s @loc{McKay Global Drill Site D}. Enter the mine and take the fan-room key from the body. Unplug the generator outside before swimming through the tunnel. Open the fan room and turn on the fans to clear the gas, then descend the shaft for Mimo Abosi’s relic.
Place the three relics in Oluwa Cave and open the chest in the new chamber. Defeat the spirit jaguar and its copies, then revive @npc{Oluso}.

achievements.description: Win a Cockfighting match
achievements.summary: Win a cockfighting match.

steps.text: At Montero Farm, collect the rooster beside the ring if needed. Start a match and win two rounds; dodge an attack, then counterattack.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Gran Premios
achievements.summary: Finish three Gran Premio races.

steps.text: Complete a Gran Premio checkpoint race within its time limit. You may replay the same race for all three finishes.

achievements.description: Win a Dominoes game
achievements.summary: Win a game of dominoes.

steps.text: Play at the dominoes table in @loc{Patriotas Peak}, El Este. Choose Civilian difficulty and match the open ends, aiming to leave fewer dots in your hand than the other players.

achievements.description: Complete a Special Operation
achievements.summary: Finish any Special Operation.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Lola} at a guerrilla camp and start a Special Operation. Recover the PG-240X, cool the device at water sources, and complete the extraction fight.

achievements.description: Successfully complete 5 Bandido Operations
achievements.summary: Finish five Bandido Operations successfully.

steps.text: At a camp’s @mechanic{Los Bandidos} board, assign a leader whose skills match an Operation.
Return when the real-time wait ends and resolve the choices, favoring high success chances. Complete five successful Operations.

achievements.description: Perform a Vehicle Machete Kill from a horse
achievements.summary: Kill a vehicle’s driver with a machete takedown from horseback.

steps.text: Ride beside the driver’s door of a moving enemy vehicle. Use the Vehicle Machete Kill prompt to jump across and kill the driver.

achievements.description: Collect 49 Unique Weapons
achievements.summary: Acquire 49 Unique Weapons.

guide.context: Only Unique Weapons count; ordinary weapon variants do not. In Arsenal, inspect a missing Unique Weapon to read its acquisition hint.

collectibles.name: Snapshot
collectibles.location: Golfo Vasto Lighthouse, Ciénaga Nublada National Park
collectibles.method: Grapple up the tower for the weapon crate.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade one Camp Facility at any Guerrilla Camp (Solo Campaign only)
achievements.summary: Upgrade one camp facility to level 3 in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Talk to the Foreman at a guerrilla camp. Build a facility and buy both upgrades to reach level 3, using the required camp resources.

achievements.description: Acquire every Supremo in Yara
achievements.summary: Obtain all seven Supremos.

steps.text: Keep the story Supremo, Exterminador. Buy Fantasma, Volta, Furioso, Médico, and Gladiador from Juan for 100 Depleted Uranium each as their ranks unlock. Complete Triada Blessings for Triador.

achievements.description: Purchase 15 Meals
achievements.summary: Buy 15 meals at La Cantina.

steps.text: Build @loc{La Cantina} through a camp Foreman and gather the meat or fish shown in two recipes.
Buy meals until you reach 15 purchases. Alternate between the two recipes so the current meal effect does not block another purchase.

achievements.description: Find 15 USB Sticks
achievements.summary: Collect all 15 USB song sticks.

guide.context: Track missing songs in Collection > USB Songs. Nearby USB sticks show a white USB icon on the minimap.

achievements.description: Unlock 15 Criptograma Chests
achievements.summary: Open all 15 Criptograma Chests.

guide.context: Each chest needs two nearby charts. Blue paint and wind chimes lead toward the charts; return to the chest after collecting both.

collectibles.name: Armonía house
collectibles.method: Take chart #06 Royal Palm from the roof and #01 Yaran Flag from the tunnel beside the house. Return to open the chest.

collectibles.name: El Dorado Cabins
collectibles.method: Find #22 Dog and #03 Pig on the beach south of the tower, then open the chest.

collectibles.name: Poesía jetty
collectibles.method: Take #10 Rooster from the rocks offshore. Follow the blue coastal marks past the lighthouse and grapple up for #25 Yara Libre.

collectibles.name: Verdera billboard
collectibles.method: Follow the blue roof markings for #16 El Trompo and #19 Sunrise Mariposa Flower, then return to the chest.

collectibles.method: Take #28 Yaran Queen Butterfly from the island directly north of the dock. Travel east to the neighboring island, then dive just off its western shore for #12 Shark on a blue plank underwater.

collectibles.name: Feroza construction yard
collectibles.method: Break the pallets at the shipping container for #23 Libertad Emblem. Break the pallet covering the wrecked car at the yard edge for #04 Starfish.

collectibles.name: Segunda watchtower
collectibles.method: Break the boards over both nearby ground holes, each beside a fuel barrel. Collect #13 Cat and #29 Soursop below ground.

collectibles.method: Climb the tall tower using grapple points and vines for #09 Tarantula. Reach the smaller western tower by wingsuit or its underwater entrance for #26 Boxing Gloves.

collectibles.name: Rubén shore
collectibles.method: Take #20 Mamey Sapote beneath the jetty. Shoot the orange net over the nearby cave entrance for #17 Coin; the cave also has a path south of the chest.

collectibles.name: The People’s Pride Clinic
collectibles.method: Search the right-hand building of the central housing block for #18 Cigar. Cross north toward the beach for #21 Croco Taxi on the next rooftop.

collectibles.name: Barriga swamps
collectibles.method: Search the hut directly north for #14 Horse and a hut on the swamp’s western edge for #30 Domino.

collectibles.name: Savannah Fields
collectibles.location: Casa Marroquín, on the north shore of Hígado Lake in Savannah Fields
collectibles.method: Climb to the rooftop with the green chair for the chest. Go southwest and break the enclosure’s wooden doors for #07 El Crocodilo. Find #27 Tocororo on a building wall a few hundred meters south of the chest.

collectibles.name: Concepción rooftops
collectibles.method: Find the rooftop with a wooden ramp beside a small utility room. Follow the northbound blue marking across the roofs, then drop into the yard for #05 Machete in a market stall. Climb the stairs and cross the roofs east for #24 Chalice.

collectibles.name: Southern rooftops
collectibles.method: Find the ground-level courtyard chest beneath a blue chest-and-key symbol, between the apartment doors. Grapple up on the left and jump to the right roof for #08 Car Clásico. Ride the zipline onward, then climb the flowering vines for #15 El Flamenco.

collectibles.name: La Divinidad Cathedral
collectibles.location: Rooftop immediately north of the cathedral
collectibles.method: Cross the roofs to the cathedral balcony for #11 Rum. Pass through the cathedral at that level and use the east-side ramp to reach the roof with #02 La Guitarra.

achievements.description: Collect all 4 Rides
achievements.summary: Unlock all four callable Rides.

steps.text: Receive @item{Juan’s 1956 Beaumont Valentina} during Fuel the Revolution.
Finish the Yaran Story @mechanic{Backseat Driver} in Madrugada for Yami’s 2008 KAG TG.
Win any Gran Premio for the @item{1962 Verrazzano Bravo}.
Visit Catalina Ridge’s FND Storage Facility. Climb the yellow excavator into the warehouse’s upper doorway. Break the pallets and boxes, then drive the @item{1985 Tokai Sabuku} outside.

achievements.description: Find all Roosters
achievements.summary: Collect the 13 roosters found in Yara.

guide.context: The six Ubisoft Connect reward roosters are optional. Use Collection > Roosters to check the 13 found in Yara.

achievements.description: Recruit 5 Amigos
achievements.summary: Recruit five Amigos.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{Guapo} during Juan of a Kind.
At Montero Farm, complete @mechanic{Who’s a Good Boy?} and @mechanic{Fetch Quest} for Chorizo.
At Álvarez Farm in Sierra Perdida, start @mechanic{Man’s Best Enemy}. Finish Pecking Orders and Wingman to recruit Chicharrón.
Shoot the lock off the blue shipping container in western @loc{Feroza} to free Boom Boom.
Finish @mechanic{Triada Blessings} to recruit Oluso.

achievements.description: Pet Guapo
achievements.summary: Pet the crocodile Guapo.

steps.text: After Juan of a Kind gives you Guapo as an Amigo, stand beside him and use the pet prompt.

achievements.description: Equip Chicharrón with the Motherclucker Outfit
achievements.summary: Dress Chicharrón in the Motherclucker outfit.

steps.text: Recruit Chicharrón through Man’s Best Enemy, Pecking Orders, and Wingman.
Open Amigos > Chicharrón > Details, select the appearance icon, and equip @item{Motherclucker}.

achievements.description: Distract 10 soldiers with Chorizo
achievements.summary: Use Chorizo to distract soldiers 10 times.

steps.text: Recruit Chorizo at Montero Farm through Who’s a Good Boy? and Fetch Quest.

Summon Chorizo, aim at an unaware soldier, and give the distraction command. Wait for each distraction to finish before issuing another; the same soldier can count again. Track 10 distractions under Chorizo’s Bloodhound ability.

achievements.description: Take out 10 soldiers with active Heat
achievements.summary: Kill 10 soldiers while Heat is active.

steps.text: Fight soldiers openly until the Heat bars beside the minimap turn red and Special Forces pursue you. Kill 10 soldiers while that Heat remains active.

achievements.description: Take out a shark with an explosion
achievements.summary: Kill a shark with an explosion.

steps.text: Take a boat to a shark hunting spot off western El Este. From the boat, kill a visible shark with a rocket launcher or another explosive.

achievements.description: Catch 10 fish
achievements.summary: Land 10 fish with the fishing rod.

steps.text: After Fuel the Revolution, equip the fishing rod at a shore. Cast, hook a bite, and reel while following the direction prompts; ease off when the line turns red. Catch 10 fish of any species.

achievements.description: Take out a soldier by sabotaging an alarm
achievements.summary: Kill a soldier with a sabotaged alarm.

guide.context: If you have cleared every suitable site, finish the campaign and use Abandon FND Base on the map to restore a base.

steps.text: Buy and equip the @item{Techmaster Band} from a level 3 Bandidos Barracks, or equip the band if you already found it.
At an enemy base or checkpoint, hold the sabotage prompt on an alarm. Destroy other alarms, leave a soldier alive, and let the soldier spot you and attempt to use the trapped alarm.

achievements.description: Take out 3 Insurgent Leaders
achievements.summary: Kill three Insurgent Leaders.

guide.context: Only one new leader is available per weekly cycle, so this spans three cycles. Special Operations require a server connection even when played solo.

steps.text: After the campaign, open @mechanic{Insurgency} and complete the listed military targets and Special Operation.
Track and kill the revealed Insurgent Leader. Complete two more weekly insurgencies after their Monday resets.

achievements.description: Take out 10 Special Forces soldiers
achievements.summary: Kill 10 Special Forces soldiers.

steps.text: Raise Heat until Special Forces arrive, then kill 10 of the heavily armored soldiers. Their tagged icons use a solid badge.

achievements.description: Disable and hijack a tank using an EMP device
achievements.summary: Disable an occupied tank with an EMP and hijack the tank.

steps.text: Buy Volta or Zeusito from Juan and use its EMP against an enemy tank.
While the tank is disabled, climb onto its roof and use the hijack prompt.

achievements.description: Hunt all Mythical Animals (Solo Campaign only)
achievements.summary: Kill all five Mythical Animals in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Upgrade the Hunting Lodge to level 3, then buy the Mythical Animal hunting maps from the lodge to add their markers.

Kill Mamutito, both Demoníaco wolves, Venodiente, and Sanguinario at their markers. Visit Sanguinario’s coastal village in southern El Este at night; fast travel away and return if the jaguar is absent.

achievements.description: Slide 200m at once
achievements.summary: Slide continuously for at least 200 meters.

steps.text: From @loc{Hideout Bolero} in southern Sierra Perdida, follow the road east uphill to the small farm. Enter the arch on the right and slide down the road while holding crouch; follow the left bend without stopping.

achievements.description: Run over 10 soldiers in a vehicle
achievements.summary: Kill 10 soldiers by running them over with vehicles.

steps.text: Drive into enemy soldiers at speed. Check that each soldier dies; kills accumulate across different vehicles and trips.

achievements.description: Use a Security Control Center to disable all cameras and alarms
achievements.summary: Switch off an FND base’s cameras and alarms through its Security Control Center.

guide.context: If the base is already clear, Abandon FND Base becomes available on the map after the campaign. Reload the autosave before capture if the attempt goes wrong.

steps.text: Visit @loc{Roca Pequeña Sat Station} in Conuco. Kill the officer and take the key to the locked security room.
Open the room and use the Security Control Center’s interaction prompt to shut down the base’s cameras and alarms. Leave another soldier alive until you have used the panel.

achievements.description: Take out a soldier from 50m above them
achievements.summary: Kill a soldier while at least 50 meters above the soldier.

steps.text: Hover an attack helicopter more than 50 meters above a soldier and kill the soldier with its rockets. Alternatively, fire a rocket launcher while parachuting from that height.

achievements.description: Have poisoned soldiers kill 5 other enemies
achievements.summary: Make poisoned soldiers kill five other enemies.

steps.text: Equip poison ammunition or El Besito and find a group of soldiers. Wound some soldiers, then poison a healthy soldier.
Hide out of sight so the poisoned soldier attacks the other enemies. Continue until poisoned soldiers have caused five kills.

achievements.description: Equip a full matching Gear Set
achievements.summary: Wear all five pieces of one matching gear set.

steps.text: In Arsenal, equip a matching head, chest, leg, foot, and wrist item. The Revolutionary set becomes available during The Lion’s Den if you have not completed another set sooner.

achievements.description: Install every Mod on a single Resolver Weapon
achievements.summary: Fill every mod slot on one Resolver Weapon.

steps.text: At a workbench, select a Resolver Weapon such as Tostador. Buy and equip one mod in each of its three slots; the three purchases require six Gun Powder in total.

achievements.description: Build one of each Camp Facility (Solo Campaign only)
achievements.summary: Build all six camp facility types in the solo campaign.

steps.text: Use the Foremen at Montero Farm, Camp Máximas, and Patriotas Peak to fill their two facility slots each. Build the Hideout Network, Guerrilla Garrison, Bandidos Barracks, La Cantina, Hunting Lodge, and Fishing Hut.

achievements.description: Have 10 parts installed on a Ride
achievements.summary: Fit 10 parts to a single Ride.

steps.text: In Rides, fill all four Offense/Defense slots and all six Cosmetics slots on one car.
For an empty slot, highlight a locked part to see its requirement. Collect vehicles at pickup points or finish Gran Premios as directed, then equip a part in that slot.

achievements.description: Reach the Rank of Comandante
achievements.summary: Reach character rank 14, Comandante.

steps.text: Earn XP from Operations, Yaran Stories, Treasure Hunts, and military targets until Arsenal shows rank 14.

achievements.description: Complete any Special Operation without exceeding 50% on the PG-240X's temperature meter
achievements.summary: Finish a Special Operation without the PG-240X temperature ever exceeding 50%.

guide.context: If the heat passes 50%, restart the Special Operation and try again.

steps.text: Start @loc{Maceo} on Standard and retrieve the PG-240X from the northwest airbase.
Return along the western edge, staying in shade and cooling the device at water sources before its heat reaches halfway. Keep the device cool through the extraction fight.

achievements.description: Locate a stash of hidden Moneda in any Special Operation
achievements.summary: Open a hidden Moneda stash in a Special Operation.

steps.text: In @loc{Mesozoico}, take the stash key from the dinosaur-head display case inside the PG-240X building.
Leave through the main entrance and follow the path roughly 100–150 meters. Open the orange chest behind the pterodactyl statue on the right.

achievements.description: Free 30 hostages during a Lola's Informants challenge in any Special Operation
achievements.summary: Rescue 30 hostages in Lola’s Informants challenges during Special Operations.

guide.context: Rescues accumulate across attempts; completing the whole Operation is unnecessary.

steps.text: Finish Maceo on Standard to unlock Mastery 1, then start Mastery 1.
Look for a red flare, defeat the guards, and untie the three hostages. Use System > Restart Special Operation and keep rescuing hostages until the total reaches 30.

achievements.description: Complete Special Operation: Cocodrilo on Mastery 3 difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the Cocodrilo Special Operation on Mastery 3.

steps.text: At Lola’s board, complete Cocodrilo on Standard, Mastery 1, and Mastery 2 to unlock Mastery 3.
Select Mastery 3, retrieve the PG-240X, and carry the device back using shade and water to control its heat. Survive the final defense and extract.

achievements.description: Complete Special Operation: Mesozoico on Mastery 3 difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the Mesozoico Special Operation on Mastery 3.

steps.text: At Lola’s board, complete Mesozoico on Standard, Mastery 1, and Mastery 2 to unlock Mastery 3.
Select Mastery 3, retrieve the PG-240X, and carry the device back using shade and water to control its heat. Survive the final defense and extract.

achievements.description: Complete Special Operation: Los Tres Santos on Mastery 3 difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the Los Tres Santos Special Operation on Mastery 3.

steps.text: At Lola’s board, complete Los Tres Santos on Standard, Mastery 1, and Mastery 2 to unlock Mastery 3.
Select Mastery 3, retrieve the PG-240X, and carry the device back using shade and water to control its heat. Survive the final defense and extract.

achievements.description: Complete Special Operation: Puerta del Edén on Mastery 3 difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the Puerta del Edén Special Operation on Mastery 3.

steps.text: At Lola’s board, complete Puerta del Edén on Standard, Mastery 1, and Mastery 2 to unlock Mastery 3.
Select Mastery 3, retrieve the PG-240X, and carry the device back using shade and water to control its heat. Survive the final defense and extract.

achievements.description: Complete Special Operation: Maceo on Mastery 3 difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish the Maceo Special Operation on Mastery 3.

steps.text: At Lola’s board, complete Maceo on Standard, Mastery 1, and Mastery 2 to unlock Mastery 3.
Select Mastery 3, retrieve the PG-240X, and carry the device back using shade and water to control its heat. Survive the final defense and extract.

achievements.description: Escape Vaas' mind
achievements.summary: Escape Vaas’s mind in the Insanity DLC.

steps.text: Follow the three red trails from The Compound and finish the three Memories to recover the Silver Dragon Blade pieces.
Return the pieces to The Compound and survive five enemy waves. Leave through the gate during the one-minute escape window.

achievements.description: Escape Vaas’ mind with a score of at least 25,000
achievements.summary: Finish an escape from Vaas’s mind with 25,000 points or more.

steps.text: After your first escape, select Mind Level 5 and complete the three blade-piece objectives. Check Scoreboard for at least 25,000 points.
Return to The Compound, survive the extraction waves, and escape through the gate to bank the score.

achievements.description: Carry at least 8,000 Cash at one time
achievements.summary: Hold at least 8,000 unspent Cash in Vaas’s mind.

steps.text: On Mind Level 5, collect Cash from enemies, chests, and objectives. Delay purchases until the on-screen balance reaches 8,000.

achievements.description: Discover every location in Vaas' mind
achievements.summary: Discover all 20 locations in Vaas’s mind.

guide.context: Discovered locations stay recorded between runs.

steps.text: Visit The Compound, the three blade-piece Memories, eight Gun Show challenges, three Trials, and the Beach, Volcanic, and Jungle Safe Houses.
Also discover The Balancing Point in the north and Checking Out. Approach each activity until its map icon appears; completing the activity is unnecessary.

achievements.description: Unlock all weapons in Vaas' Armory (Solo Game only)
achievements.summary: Unlock all nine weapon cases in Vaas’s Armory while playing solo.

steps.text: Buy the starting pistol, then complete all eight Gun Show challenges. Open each challenge chest and defeat its enemies to unlock the grenade launcher, SMG, auto-pistol, sniper rifle, bow, rifle, machine gun, and shotgun.
Check the Armory at The Compound or a safe house for any case still locked.

achievements.description: Collect all of Vaas' Diary Pages
achievements.summary: Collect all seven diary pages in Vaas’s mind.

guide.context: Collected pages persist between runs. Check Collection > Diary Pages for missing titles.

collectibles.name: We’re All Mad Here I
collectibles.method: Check the wall beside the stairs, left of the Armory.

collectibles.name: We’re All Mad Here II
collectibles.method: Enter the container just north of the first page.

collectibles.name: We’re All Mad Here III
collectibles.location: Path to the northern blade piece
collectibles.method: Take the page from the corpse on the approach.

collectibles.name: We’re All Mad Here IV
collectibles.method: Search the locker one room below the blade piece.

collectibles.name: We’re All Mad Here V
collectibles.method: Jump into the water-filled hole. Continue into the hotel and search the room entered after taking the hotel keys.

collectibles.name: We’re All Mad Here VI
collectibles.method: Dive through the underwater window and open the submerged doors. The matching doors above water open; enter the house and check the downstairs desk.

collectibles.name: We’re All Mad Here VII
collectibles.method: Search the building beside the loot chest.

achievements.description: Collect all of the Vaas Chibis
achievements.summary: Destroy all 10 Vaas Chibis in Insanity.

guide.context: Destroy each figurine with a shot. Collection > Chibis records the in-game numbers across runs.

collectibles.name: Chibi 01
collectibles.location: The Compound, building beside the spawn building
collectibles.method: Look above the workbench at the ceiling and shoot the figurine.

collectibles.name: Chibi 03
collectibles.location: Volcanic slope southwest of The Compound
collectibles.method: Climb the raised structure and shoot the figurine at the top.

collectibles.name: Chibi 02
collectibles.location: Northern beach, west of Beach Safe House
collectibles.method: Shoot the figurine on the boat offshore.

collectibles.name: Chibi 06
collectibles.location: Mountain south of the northern beach
collectibles.method: Walk up the mountain from the south and look along the end of the wooden ramp.

collectibles.name: Chibi 04
collectibles.location: Sandy ground south of the northern red-water lake
collectibles.method: Look inside the bucket for the figurine.

collectibles.name: Chibi 08
collectibles.location: River bend east of the northern blade-piece route
collectibles.method: Look on the wall to the left of the loot chest.

collectibles.name: Chibi 09
collectibles.method: Find the hanging upside-down corpse and shoot the figurine held in its hands.

collectibles.name: Chibi 10
collectibles.location: Eastern beach, north of the southern blade objective
collectibles.method: Look along the rocks above the water at the map boundary.

collectibles.name: Chibi 07
collectibles.location: Central hillside east of The Compound
collectibles.method: Search the statue’s hands.

collectibles.name: Chibi 05
collectibles.location: South of The Compound, west of the southern blade objective
collectibles.method: Circle the tree and shoot the figurine inside the hole in the trunk.

achievements.description: Collect all of the Visions in Vaas' mind
achievements.summary: Record all 18 visions in Vaas’s mind.

guide.context: Stay for each vision until the collectible notification appears. Running ahead can end a scene before it counts; replay the relevant objective in another DLC run to recover a missed vision. Collected visions persist.

collectibles.name: 01 — Family
collectibles.location: Path toward the northern blade objective
collectibles.method: Stop beside the rock in the red water and watch Vaas until the collectible notification appears.

collectibles.name: 02 — Rebel
collectibles.method: After climbing the plants, move slowly into the corridor and watch the scene.

collectibles.name: 03 — Scripts
collectibles.method: Let the next scene finish before advancing.

collectibles.name: 04 — Birthright
collectibles.method: Watch the scene between the first and second phases.

collectibles.name: 05 — Fatal Flaws
collectibles.method: Watch the next scene before continuing the battle.

collectibles.name: 06 — Temptress
collectibles.method: Watch the scene where you land after the floor gives way.

collectibles.name: 16 — Addict
collectibles.method: Dive through the window and open the submerged doors to unlock the matching doors above. Bring all three medicines from the house to the garden building, then watch the scene.

collectibles.name: 15 — Copycat Motherf*ers
collectibles.method: Watch the scene after taking the blade piece.

collectibles.name: 13 — Meet Cute
collectibles.method: Watch the scene after taking the blade piece.

collectibles.name: 14 — Roleplay
collectibles.method: Watch the scene at the large hole before jumping into the water below.

collectibles.name: 17 — Redefined
collectibles.method: Stop for every Vaas speech. Let the final speech at the hotel door finish, including Vaas raising both hands.

collectibles.name: 07 — Room 1991
collectibles.method: Watch the room’s scene completely.

collectibles.name: 08 — Room 2003
collectibles.method: Stay until the scene ends.

collectibles.name: 09 — Room 2006
collectibles.method: Wait for the vision to finish before leaving.

collectibles.name: 10 — Room 2007
collectibles.method: Watch the full scene.

collectibles.name: 11 — Room 2012
collectibles.method: Let the memory finish before moving onward.

collectibles.name: 12 — Final Room
collectibles.method: Watch the final hotel scene to completion.

collectibles.name: 18 — Warrior
collectibles.location: The Compound after gathering three blade pieces
collectibles.method: Speak to the vision to begin extraction and watch the scene.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade all Weapon Cases in Vaas' Armory (Solo Game only)
achievements.summary: While playing solo, upgrade every weapon case in Vaas’s Armory to the maximum level.

steps.text: At The Compound or a safe house, upgrade every unlocked weapon case until all nine are gold.
For more Cash, replay the Trials on Mind Level 5 and sell unwanted Powers. Return to a safe house before quitting to the menu, then start another run to repeat the Trials.

achievements.description: Escape Vaas' mind at Mind Level 5
achievements.summary: Escape Vaas’s mind on Mind Level 5.

steps.text: After escaping on Mind Level 1, start a new run at Mind Level 5. Set Gameplay > Game Difficulty to Story Mode if desired.
Upgrade your pistol and buy health and syringe-capacity Traits. Collect the three blade pieces, then survive five waves at The Compound and leave through the gate.

achievements.description: Escape Pagan's mind
achievements.summary: Escape Pagan’s mind in the Control DLC.

steps.text: Follow the yellow trails and collect the three mask pieces from Rewriting History, Playing God, and For King and Country.
Bring the mask to the Royal Palace in the northeast. Survive five enemy waves, then leave through the gate within the one-minute escape window.

achievements.description: Escape Pagan's mind with a score of at least 25,000
achievements.summary: Finish an escape from Pagan’s mind with 25,000 points or more.

steps.text: Play on Mind Level 5 and complete the three mask objectives. Check Scoreboard to confirm at least 25,000 points.
Finish the Royal Palace defense and leave through the escape gate.

achievements.description: Carry at least 8,000 Respect at once
achievements.summary: Hold at least 8,000 unspent Respect in Pagan’s mind.

steps.text: Collect Respect on Mind Level 5 without spending until the balance reaches 8,000. Complete objectives and loot enemy drops and chests while staying alive.

achievements.description: Discover every location in Pagan's mind
achievements.summary: Reveal every location in Pagan’s mind, totaling 21.

guide.context: You only need to discover the activities, and discoveries remain recorded between runs.

steps.text: Reveal the eight Armory challenges, three Trials, and Lakeside, Country, and Mountain Safe Houses by approaching their icons.
Find the Delusions Sound and Fury, House on Fire, and Thicker Than Water, plus all three mask Memories. Gather the three mask pieces to enter the Royal Palace for the final location.

achievements.description: Unlock all weapons in Pagan's Armory (Solo Game only)
achievements.summary: Unlock all nine weapon cases in Pagan’s Armory while playing solo.

steps.text: Buy the starting pistol and finish the eight Armory challenges for the bow, machine gun, shotgun, grenade launcher, SMG, rifle, sniper rifle, and auto-pistol.
At each challenge, open the large chest and defeat the required enemies. Check the starting Armory for any case still locked; upgrades are optional.

achievements.description: Collect all of Pagan's Diary Pages
achievements.summary: Collect all seven diary pages in Pagan’s mind.

guide.context: Pages stay collected between runs. Collection > Diary Pages lists the missing titles.

collectibles.name: Kyrati TV Guide I
collectibles.method: Descend the ramp and check the wooden post on the left.

collectibles.name: Kyrati TV Guide II
collectibles.method: Look on the rock beside the red candles.

collectibles.name: Kyrati TV Guide V
collectibles.method: Take the page from the wooden post at the main objective.

collectibles.name: Kyrati TV Guide VI
collectibles.method: Search the wooden post at the main objective.

collectibles.name: Kyrati TV Guide VII
collectibles.method: Activate the gold statue and finish the defense. Enter the cave to the statue’s right through the opened gate and search the wall.

collectibles.name: Kyrati TV Guide IV
collectibles.location: For King and Country in the southeast
collectibles.method: After climbing the wooden boards, enter the cave. Take the page from the orange shelf ahead.

collectibles.name: Kyrati TV Guide III
collectibles.method: Gather all three mask pieces to enter, then search between the Mirror and the Armory.

achievements.description: Collect all of the Pagan Chibis
achievements.summary: Destroy all 10 Pagan Chibis in Control.

guide.context: Shoot the figures to collect them. Your Collection > Chibis record persists between runs.

collectibles.name: Chibi 01
collectibles.location: West of the spawn area, above the western waterfall
collectibles.method: Look along the tree branches for the figurine.

collectibles.name: Chibi 05
collectibles.location: Above Bell Tower Ruins on the western cliff
collectibles.method: Climb the inverted tower and follow the rocky summit path. Pass the figurine’s rock, then turn and look upward.

collectibles.name: Chibi 06
collectibles.location: Cliff path behind Rewriting History in the northwest
collectibles.method: Climb the rocks behind the houses and follow the upper cliff path to the eagle’s nest.

collectibles.name: Chibi 10
collectibles.location: Hut east of Rewriting History, south of the northern path
collectibles.method: Shoot the crate underneath the hut to expose the figurine.

collectibles.name: Chibi 02
collectibles.location: Hut north of the western waterfall
collectibles.method: Climb the side of the hut and shoot the figurine on the roof.

collectibles.name: Chibi 03
collectibles.location: Hut on the northern shore of the central lake
collectibles.method: Look beneath the hut at its wooden support beam.

collectibles.name: Chibi 07
collectibles.location: Hill northwest of the Royal Palace, north of the lake
collectibles.method: Shoot the figurine on top of the pillar.

collectibles.name: Chibi 09
collectibles.location: Flooded riverside cave south of the Royal Palace
collectibles.method: From the riverbank, look into the cave. Shoot the figurine on the small wall shelf right of the purple Respect chest.

collectibles.name: Chibi 04
collectibles.location: Cliff east of the central lake
collectibles.method: Look over the edge for the hanging figurine.

collectibles.name: Chibi 08
collectibles.location: Exit cliffs of For King and Country in the southeast
collectibles.method: Defeat the boss and collect the mask piece. Before using the exit zipline, walk right and look high up the cliff for the figurine.

achievements.description: Collect all of the Visions in Pagan's mind
achievements.summary: Record all 16 visions in Pagan’s mind.

guide.context: Each statue route in Thicker Than Water needs a separate run. Quit from a safe house between routes. After restarting, repeat the statue-head puzzle to drain the chamber again before choosing the next statue. Watch every vision to its end; missed scenes return on a replay and recorded scenes stay collected.

collectibles.name: 01 — Second Draft
collectibles.method: Watch the vision at the end of the mask objective.

collectibles.name: 02 — Storybook Ending
collectibles.method: Watch the scene after completing the mask objective.

collectibles.name: 03 — Power Struggle
collectibles.location: For King and Country, right tunnel
collectibles.method: Finish the right-side tunnel and watch the scene.

collectibles.name: 04 — Leverage
collectibles.location: For King and Country, left tunnel
collectibles.method: Finish the left-side tunnel and watch the scene.

collectibles.name: 05 — Indomitable
collectibles.location: For King and Country, boss room
collectibles.method: Defeat the flamethrower boss and watch the vision.

collectibles.name: 09 — Self-Reflection
collectibles.method: Restore the headless statue above the water: climb the rocks and vines opposite it, break the boards, and drop down for the head. Replace the head to drain the water. Select the Pagan statue below and enter the central door; watch both scenes.

collectibles.name: 10 — New Beginnings
collectibles.method: Stay on the same statue route for the second vision and let the scene finish.

collectibles.name: 07 — Cold Feet
collectibles.location: Second statue from the left, baby
collectibles.method: On a new run, restore the statue head again to drain the chamber. Select the baby statue, second from the left, then enter the door and watch the scene.

collectibles.name: 08 — Change of Heart
collectibles.location: Second statue from the left, baby
collectibles.method: Stay on the same statue route for the second vision and let the scene finish.

collectibles.name: 06 — First Sight
collectibles.location: First statue on the right, woman
collectibles.method: In another run, select the woman. In her room, use the passport on the right and pen on the left. Take the wheel beside the pen and operate both wheels beside the large gate. Enter for the vision.

collectibles.name: 12 — Daddy Issues
collectibles.method: In another run, select the headless man. Follow the left corridor, take its key, unlock the bar, and watch the scene.

collectibles.name: 11 — Patriarch
collectibles.method: Take the key on the corridor’s right side and unlock the door at its end. Watch the scene inside.

collectibles.name: 13 — Titles
collectibles.method: Find the key in the bathroom’s bloody puddle. Open the central corridor’s door and use the book. Return outside to the statues after viewing all four statue routes for the final scene.
collectibles.note: If Titles does not appear, replay a statue route and watch its visions again before returning outside.

collectibles.name: 14 — Low Point
collectibles.location: Two houses in the eastern Delusion
collectibles.method: Take the key from the right house’s front door and unlock the left house. Climb the downstairs shelves for the first book, then climb the ladder for the second book and another key. Enter the right house through the broken upper balcony. Unlock its door, crouch beneath the fallen shelves for the third book, and drop downstairs for the fourth behind the ladder. Leave the houses to trigger the vision.

collectibles.name: 15 — Reverie
collectibles.method: Gather the three mask pieces to enter the palace and watch the daughter’s greeting before the Mirror and Armory.

collectibles.name: 16 — Happily Ever After
collectibles.location: Family table beyond the left-hand palace door
collectibles.method: Watch the family scene completely before using the chair. Sitting early ends the vision; replay the palace in another run if missed.

achievements.description: Have 8 Power equipped at one time
achievements.summary: Equip eight Powers at the same time in Pagan’s mind.

steps.text: Buy the seven additional Power slots for 10,700 Respect in total.
Collect heart-shaped Powers from defeated enemies, chests, and Trials, then fill all eight slots without selling the equipped Powers.

achievements.displayName: What's a King to a God?
achievements.description: Escape Pagan's mind at Mind Level 5
achievements.summary: Escape Pagan’s mind on Mind Level 5.

steps.text: After the first escape, select Mind Level 5 and choose Story Mode in Gameplay options if desired. Upgrade your preferred weapons, health, and syringe capacity.
Recover the three mask pieces, survive the Royal Palace defense, and use the escape gate.

achievements.description: Successfully escape Joseph's mind
achievements.summary: Escape Joseph’s mind in the Collapse DLC.

steps.text: On Mind Level 1, finish the cross-piece Memories Divine Justice, In the Beginning, and What Child Is This?.
Follow the final objective with the completed cross. Survive the required enemy waves and use the escape opportunity when it appears.

achievements.description: Escape Joseph's mind with a score of at least 25,000
achievements.summary: Finish an escape from Joseph’s mind with 25,000 points or more.

steps.text: On Mind Level 5, complete the three cross-piece objectives and collect score from enemies and activities.
Check Scoreboard before leaving the final defense. Continue fighting extra waves if the score is below 25,000, then escape.

achievements.description: Carry at least 8,000 Penance at one time
achievements.summary: Hold at least 8,000 unspent Penance in Joseph’s mind.

steps.text: Replay the three Trials on Mind Level 5 and collect enemy drops. Keep your Penance unspent until the balance reaches 8,000.

achievements.description: Discover every location in Joseph's mind
achievements.summary: Discover every activity location in Joseph’s mind.

steps.text: Explore until the map reveals all eight Tests of Faith, the Hilltop, Cliffside, and Valley Safe Houses, and the three Trials: YES, Act of Faith, and Cull the Herd.
Also reveal the three Revelations: Providence, Graven Image, and The Book of Joseph. Visit each cross-piece Memory too, approaching until the map icon appears.

achievements.description: Unlock all weapons in Joseph's Armory (Solo Game only)
achievements.summary: Unlock every weapon case in Joseph’s Armory while playing solo.

steps.text: Complete the eight Tests of Faith at lock icons: bow, rifle, shotgun, auto-pistol, grenade launcher, machine gun, SMG, and sniper rifle.
Open each challenge chest and defeat its enemies. Check the Armory to confirm the starting pistol and all eight challenge weapons are unlocked.

achievements.description: Collect all of Joseph's Diary Pages
achievements.summary: Collect every diary page in Joseph’s mind.

guide.context: Check Collection > Diary Pages for the pages still missing. The trial pages can be collected while their objective is active.

collectibles.method: Search the small table at the gate’s left pillar, beside the chalice and cross.

collectibles.name: Book of Joseph II

collectibles.method: Look on the trunk at the roots.

collectibles.name: Book of Joseph III

collectibles.name: Book of Joseph VI
collectibles.location: Fall’s End Church during In the Beginning
collectibles.method: Once the church opens, search the piano beside the altar.

achievements.description: Collect all of the Joseph Chibis
achievements.summary: Collect all 10 Joseph Chibis in Collapse.

guide.context: Shoot each figurine and use Collection > Chibis to track its in-game number.

collectibles.method: Shoot the figurine on top of the square stone pillar at the banner arch.

collectibles.name: Chibi 05
collectibles.location: Sniper-rifle challenge area in the southwest
collectibles.method: Shoot the figurine above the hanging body on the wooden torture frame.

collectibles.name: Chibi 04

collectibles.method: Look up the metal tower and shoot the figurine on its crossbeam.

collectibles.name: Chibi 10

collectibles.method: Find the headless ram statue and shoot the figurine on the wooden post below it.

collectibles.method: Enter the silo and look up at the circular rim beneath its mesh roof.

collectibles.name: Chibi 01

collectibles.method: Shoot the figurine on the top of the J in JAIL.

collectibles.name: Chibi 07
collectibles.location: Approach to Fall’s End Church in the northwest
collectibles.method: Look up at the green lamp hanging from a wooden post. Shoot the figurine on top of the lamp.

achievements.description: Collect all of the Visions in Joseph's mind
achievements.summary: Record all eight visions in Joseph’s mind.

guide.context: Stay until each vision finishes and its collectible notification appears. If you leave too early, replay the relevant objective in another DLC run.

steps.text: Start Providence at the trailer northeast of The Garden and take the elevator into the bunker. Complete John’s letter puzzle and watch his scene, then stop in the bedroom off the corridor for the next scene.
Continue Providence through the overgrown rooms. Restore power to clear the gas, find Faith’s dress, and watch the scene that follows.

In the inverted bunker section, follow the route through the vent to Jacob’s music box. Activate the box and watch his scene. Finish Providence and watch Joseph in the final office for its fifth vision.
During What Child Is This? in New Eden, watch the scene at the hanging body. Find False Ethan, carry the body back to the altar, and watch the second scene there.
During In the Beginning at Fall’s End Church, collect the cross piece from the altar and stay for the full church vision.

achievements.description: Unlock all of Joseph's traits in the Mirror
achievements.summary: Purchase every Mirror Trait in Joseph’s mind.

steps.text: At a Mirror, buy every upgrade in Pride, Greed, Joseph’s Wrath, Sloth, and Envy.
Farm the three Trials on Mind Level 5 for Penance. Kill the gold rodents that appear and sell unwanted Powers, then spend the Penance on the remaining Traits.

achievements.description: Escape Joseph's mind at Mind Level 5
achievements.summary: Escape Joseph’s mind on Mind Level 5.

steps.text: Finish one run on Mind Level 1 to unlock the other Mind Levels, then select Mind Level 5.
Upgrade your weapons and Mirror Traits. Complete the three cross-piece objectives, survive the final defense, and escape.

achievements.description: Escape the Encasement with Fai's help
achievements.summary: Defeat the Dunia Vessel and escape the Encasement with Fai.

steps.text: Collect all five Vessel Shards. In the final area, defeat the @enemy{Dunia Vessel} and finish the escape.

achievements.description: Collect all 5 Vessel Shards
achievements.summary: Recover all five Vessel Shards in Lost Between Worlds.

steps.text: Complete the first run along its required purple route to earn the Fractal Bomb.
On later runs, use the Rift map to choose routes ending at shards you have not recovered. Complete each shard’s challenge and return with the shard until all five are collected.

achievements.description: Enter the portal and complete Fractured Fortress
achievements.summary: Complete Fractured Fortress in Lost Between Worlds.

steps.text: Start Lost Between Worlds and follow Fai through the first portal. Defeat the enemies and reach Fractured Fortress’s exit.

achievements.description: Complete 5 consecutive rifts without using glints to respawn
achievements.summary: Finish five consecutive rifts without spending glints to respawn.

steps.text: Choose Explorer difficulty and finish a five-rift run without dying or using a glint revival. If you use a revival, begin another sequence of five rifts.

achievements.description: Complete a run in Lost Between Worlds in 15 minutes
achievements.summary: Finish a five-rift run in Lost Between Worlds within 15 minutes.

steps.text: Collect the five shards first to unlock the movement gear. Start a new run on Explorer difficulty.
Leave Fractured Fortress by the purple rift. In The Maze, reach the middle and use a Fractal Bomb to open the shortcut toward the purple exit to Storm Runner.
Cross Storm Runner between purple safe zones, climb its tower, and take the orange rift to Death by Darkness.
Kill enemies along the route to keep the sun up. At the exits, grapple upward and take the orange rift to Surging Shard.
Take the shard and stand beside each required crystal until it bursts, then cross the newly formed bridge. Finish the shard route before 15 minutes have passed.

achievements.description: Take out 25 Defense Units with gadgets
achievements.summary: Kill 25 Defense Units with gadgets in Lost Between Worlds.

steps.text: Take a damaging gadget from the chest before the first rifts. Use the gadget to kill Defense Units, and restock from ammunition crates until you have 25 gadget kills.

achievements.description: Take out 10 Defense Units with melee attacks in one run of The Maze
achievements.summary: Kill 10 Defense Units with melee attacks during one visit to The Maze.

steps.text: Enter @loc{The Maze} on Explorer difficulty. Kill 10 Defense Units with melee attacks before leaving that rift.

achievements.description: Swim to a depth of 185 meters in Sunken Esperanza
achievements.summary: Reach 185 meters underwater in Sunken Esperanza.

steps.text: After the first diving section in @loc{Sunken Esperanza}, clear the enemy room. Use the second diving entrance in the opposite corner.
Follow the underwater route into the church. Swim through the doorway left of the altar, head outside, and descend into the dark water until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Take out 20 Defense Units in one run of Death by Darkness
achievements.summary: Kill 20 Defense Units during one visit to Death by Darkness.

steps.text: In @loc{Death by Darkness}, follow the route and kill each Defense Unit you encounter. Reach 20 kills before exiting; the kills also keep daylight active.

achievements.description: Blow up 30 Defense Units as Fai in Comandante Fai
achievements.summary: Kill 30 Defense Units with Fai’s bombs in Comandante Fai.

steps.text: At each @loc{Comandante Fai} encounter, take control of Fai and place bombs beside groups of Defense Units. Aim to catch multiple enemies in each blast.
Use every Fai bombing opportunity, including those in the final area. Replay the rift if needed; the 30 kills can accumulate across attempts.

achievements.description: Complete Color Combat without Dani's health falling to a critical level
achievements.summary: Finish Color Combat without Dani’s health ever becoming critical.

steps.text: Choose Explorer difficulty for @loc{Color Combat}. Match your shield color to incoming red or blue attacks while defeating the enemies.
Heal when health falls near halfway and reach the exit. If health becomes critical, retry the rift for a clean attempt.
